reserveReview.rationale: At Monad block 117685630, hash 0x1311021b59af0126067744950cb1b7258594a05e3e8efabccdfe607ca7a4343b, timestamped 2026-10-29T18:37:57Z, the LVUSD issuer's owner() resolved to 0x135951057cfccca7e8ef87ee41318d670f723f68 and its transparency() to 0x0ef8fd8f36cae470aff8b9d9bbd2e5f44fb23d51. getAllVaults() returned one vault, 0xc69d584b3118e94b3443cc6c67076281242fa704, whose reserveToken() was USDC at 0x754704bc059f8c67012fed69bc8a327a5aafb603; the vault's USDC balance was 916,509.772695 and LVUSD totalSupply() was 1,416,510.772695 at the same block. USDC reports 6 decimals and LVUSD 18. LeverUp's re-fetched documentation and August 28 design disclosure explain that trader profit and loss can cause USDC reserves and circulating LVUSD to diverge. The 500,001 LVUSD shortfall is unchanged at this observation and remains a coverage risk, not a second reserve asset; MON collateral supports the separate LVMON token. This snapshot inventories the issuer-designated reserve vaults, not incidental tokens sent to the vault or a proof of the contracts' full liabilities.
